people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.
translations.bsb: So Joseph’s master took him and had him thrown into the prison where the king’s prisoners were confined. While Joseph was there in the prison,
